Defines Go structs for deserializing Red Hat OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) XML definitions used for vulnerability scanning and package state assessment.

## Key Components

### Top-Level Structure
- **`Root`** — Root element (`<oval_definitions>`) containing all OVAL data sections
- **`Generator`** — Metadata about the OVAL document producer (product, schema version, timestamp)
- **`Definitions`** / **`Definition`** — CVE/advisory definitions with affected platforms, references, criteria, and advisory details

### Advisory & CVE Types
- **`Advisory`** — Security advisory with severity, CPE list, CVE list, Bugzilla references, and issued/updated dates
- **`Cve`** — Individual CVE entry with CVSS2/3 scores, CWE, impact, and public date
- **`Bugzilla`** — Bugzilla ticket reference with ID, URL, and title
- **`AffectedPkgs`** — Resolution states and affected package components

### Tests
- **`RpminfoTest`** — RPM package info test (most common; checks package version/existence)
- **`RpmverifyfileTest`** — RPM file verification test
- **`Textfilecontent54Test`** — Text file content pattern match test
- **`UnameTest`** — Kernel/OS uname test
- **`ObjectRef`** / **`StateRef`** — Cross-reference links between tests, objects, and states

### Objects
- **`RpminfoObject`** — Identifies an RPM package by name
- **`RpmverifyfileObject`** — RPM file with detailed verification behaviors (md5, size, mode, etc.)
- **`Textfilecontent54Object`** — File path and regex pattern for content matching
- **`UnameObject`** — Uname system object reference

### States
- **`RpminfoState`** — Expected RPM EVR (epoch-version-release) and arch values
- **`RpmverifyfileState`** — Expected name/version for file verification
- **`Textfilecontent54State`** — Expected text content match
- **`UnameState`** — Expected OS release string

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "os"

    "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/redhat"
)

func main() {
    data, _ := os.ReadFile("rhel-oval.xml")

    var root redhat.Root
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    for _, def := range root.Definitions.Definitions {
        // Access CVE advisory info
        for _, cve := range def.Advisory.Cves {
            _ = cve.CveID   // e.g. "CVE-2023-1234"
            _ = cve.Cvss3   // e.g. "7.5/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H"
        }
        // Walk criteria tree for package test references
        for _, criterion := range def.Criteria.Criterions {
            _ = criterion.TestRef // links to Tests section
        }
    }
}
```
